reproduction.poolWasmDetail: Rebuilt from deploymentCommit with Rust 1.97.1 and the released Stellar CLI 30.0.1 (#f2a7b741; GitHub asset digest 48c70074020e09af0a3ebbd2bf62d53c9aec47935e49a112d3cd90fb4e37658f) via `stellar contract build --optimize`: pool (830977a5…, 43,033 B) and pool-gvk (0b034947…, 49,086 B) are byte-identical to the WASM fetched from Testnet on 2026-11-27.
reproduction.otherContracts: asp-membership, asp-non-membership, public-key-registry and the three Groth16 verifiers (which embed their verification key) are verified against Testnet by hash, not yet rebuilt from source.
reproduction.proofAgainstLiveVerifierDetail: A Groth16 proof generated with the released policy_tx_2_2_B proving key (upstream prover, Rust 1.97.1) is accepted by the live verifier CCGCOFDO... in a read-only simulation; tampered input, tampered proof, missing input and wrong-verifier cases are rejected. Evidence and replay: integrations/evidence/nethermind-policy-b-testnet-verifier.v1.json, `verify_privacy_dependency_lock.py --live-proof`.
integrationRules: The Groth16 verifier alone accepts non-canonical public inputs (x + r). The pool rejects them before verifying (NonCanonicalPublicInput = 13). StealthBridge must never call a verifier directly without canonicalizing public inputs.
